note: What gt_farm_item.py needs to size a packet for a hosted engine. A figure is a number only where an official page stated it (verified: the date it was read; 2026-10-25 through a summarising fetch, so self-verified, not read from the raw page). null means unverified: a packet is not built from an unverified window or output cap. A profile with no `verified` date, or one older than stale_days, blocks a packet build with the reason. Keys are references, never values.

gemini.plan: unverified: the plan tier (Free, or Tier 1-3 by billing and spend) is the owner's account; the tier rules were read 2026-10-25 (Tier 1 billing linked; Tier 2 100 USD spend and 3 days; Tier 3 1000 USD and 30 days)
gemini.model_notes: window and max_output hold for all five models. The gemini-2.5-* models are access-limited to users who used them before (2026-10-25): a risk for a new engine row. No default model is chosen here; the farm table row names one.
